candidats.titre: File:1974 AMC Ambassador station wagon in Daisy Yellow and woodgrain at Macungie PA show 07of15.jpg
candidats.description: 1974 AMC Ambassador Brougham station wagon. A full-sized luxurious car built by American Motors Corporation (AMC). This was the last model year for the Ambassador, at the time it was one of the longest continuous automobile nameplates - used since 1932). All Ambassadors were equipped with V8 engines, automatic transmissions, power steering and disk brakes, air conditioning, radio, and numerous other standard comfort features. Interiors featured luxurious upholstery and trim as well as 50-50 individually adjustable and reclining front seats. This car is finished in Daisy Yellow (paint code F4)
